title: The US needs a total defence strategy
gist: The authors warn the US is losing an ongoing 'irregular world war' fought below traditional armed conflict, as Iran, Russia and China attack critical infrastructure via cyber and hybrid tactics; they urge Washington to adopt the whole-of-society 'total defence' model pioneered by Sweden, Finland and the Baltics to build resilience.

insights.claim: The authors argue the US is at risk of losing an ongoing 'irregular world war' fought below the level of traditional armed conflict, in a 'grey zone' where adversaries can deny operations and escape consequences.
insights.speaker: Alexander Noyes and Jason C. Moyer
insights.so_what: Reframes national security risk around persistent hybrid attacks rather than conventional war, relevant to cybersecurity, infrastructure and defence spending priorities.
